title: Boardroom-ready client recap and risk mitigation plan
content:
PURPOSE:
This is a boardroom-ready one-pager + email template to use when preparing an executive-level QBR for strategic customers. Designed for the sponsor briefing (CRO/CPO-level) plus a short customer-facing quarterly recap email. Keep it tight — 1 page for execs, 3 bullets of impact, 3 risks with mitigations, and a clear renewal ask.

HOW TO USE (quick):
- Populate metric placeholders and adoption heatmap before internal prep call.
- Run the risk heatmap with Solutions Eng + Account Executive one week before the sponsor meeting.
- Share the customer-facing email within 48 hours of the QBR.

EXECUTIVE ONE-PAGER (Boardroom slide copy)
Title: [Customer Name] — Q[ ] [YYYY] Executive Snapshot
Owner / Sponsor: [Customer Sponsor Name] / [Redwood AE]
Duration: Intended 8–10 minutes in an executive meeting (slide 1 of QBR pack)

1) 30-second lead summary:
- Current state: Production usage across X product lines; primary model: [model-name] (hosted), region: us-west-2.
- Impact: ~[X%] reduction in inference latency, estimated $[Y] cost savings vs prior stack, and [Z] user-facing KPI improvement (e.g., search CTR +2.4pts).

2) Key metrics (last 90 days):
- Revenue / ARR covered by contract: [ARR]
- Avg tokens per minute (p50/p95): [p50] / [p95]
- TTFB (hosted): [ms]
- Errors / 100k requests: [rate]
- Cost per 1M tokens (observed): $[cost]
- Adoption growth (MoM active routes): +[X%]

3) Adoption heatmap (who uses what) — small bullets for execs:
- Billing / Finance: embeddings for invoice classification (14% of calls)
- Product Search: reranker model (42% of latency-sensitive traffic)
- Support Automation: chat fallback + routing (30% of generative volume)
- Experimental/Dev: low-volume new routes (14%)

4) Top 3 wins to highlight (customer impact):
- Production cutover completed: moved 3 routes to dedicated capacity — stable p95 latency and predictable spend.
- Cost optimization: quantization suggested for two heavy models; pilot reduced spend by ~18% with minor quality delta.
- Reliability improvement: automatic fallback policy prevented outage during cross-region maintenance.

5) Top 3 risks + mitigations (board-level framing):
- Risk: Renewal concentration on a single product team (business risk if they deprioritize)
  Mitigation: Exec sponsor ask to broaden architecture adoption; we propose a cross-functional pilot for Product + Support.
- Risk: Model quality regression from upstream changes causing user-facing drift
  Mitigation: Activate continuous evals + prompt set monitoring; propose monthly quality checkpoints with Applied ML.
- Risk: Contract usage spike causing latency SLO violations near renewal
  Mitigation: Pre-reserve burst capacity and establish fallback variants for critical routes.

6) Renewal posture & ask (clear CTA for exec):
- Current renewal window: [Renewal Date]
- Current ARR: [ARR]
- Proposed ask: Convert pilot capacity to 12-month Dedicated reservation at X GPUs or commit $[amount] (three options attached).
- Executive ask: Short internal decision window (2 weeks) to approve expanded commitment; Redwood will provide a 10% credit for early acceptance.

7) Proposed agenda for the sponsor meeting (8–12m):
- 2m: One-sentence strategic alignment (why Redwood matters to their product goals)
- 3m: Impact summary (numbers + top wins)
- 2m: Risks and mitigations (board-level recommendations)
- 2m: Renewal options and proposed decision timeline
- 1–3m: Q&A / next steps assignment

8) Attachments to include with the board pack (internal):
- Full usage breakdown (detailed token and route-level metrics csv)
- Cost model scenarios (3 pricing/commitment options)
- Quality regression plots (recent evals)

-----
CUSTOMER-FACING QUARTERLY RECAP EMAIL (send within 48 hours of QBR)
Subject: [Customer Name] Q[ ] Recap — key wins, risks, and next steps
From: Priya Nair, Sr. Customer Success Manager (Redwood)
To: [Sponsor Name], [Lead Product Manager], [Ops Lead]
Cc: [Redwood AE], [Solutions Eng], [Applied ML contact]

Hi [Sponsor Name],

Thanks again for your time in yesterday’s QBR. Short recap and agreed next steps below so your execs have a clean readout.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- User impact: [brief user KPI improvement statement]
- Cost/perf: p95 latency now [ms]; estimated run-rate savings $[Y/month].
- Reliability: No critical incidents in the last 60d; automatic fallback proved effective during maintenance.

RISKS WE’RE TRACKING (and what we’re doing):
- Quality drift on route: [route-name] — Applied ML has a daily eval and will flag regressions; we’ve added a rollback policy.
- Capacity plan: potential spike in X region — Solutions Eng will enable burst capacity on week-of [date].

AGREED NEXT STEPS & OWNERS:
- Redwood: Send formal renewal options deck by [date] — Priya Nair (CS)
- Customer: Confirm cross-functional pilot participants (Product, Support) by [date] — [Sponsor Name]
- Technical: Complete quantization pilot rollout for 2 models by [date] — Samir (SE)

If you want a 10–15m sync with your CTO before the renewal window closes, we can set that up next week.

Best,
Priya Nair
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage-breakdown.csv, renewal-options.pdf, quality-eval-zip

-----
QUICK RENEWAL TRACKER (for internal use — copy into tracker spreadsheet)
- Customer: [Customer Name]
- Renewal date: [Renewal Date]
- ARR: [ARR]
- Current risk: amber / red / green: [amber]
- Next internal review: [date]
- AE owner: [AE name]
- CS owner: Priya Nair
- Executive sponsor engaged: [Sponsor Name] (Y/N)

ACTION LOG (short):
- [2026-02-15] Quantization pilot kickoff — Samir (SE) — in progress
- [2026-02-20] Draft renewal options deck sent — Priya — awaiting feedback
- [2026-02-25] Exec sponsor slot requested (30 min) — AE to confirm

NOTES & TALKING POINTS (for sponsor):
- Emphasize business outcomes vs technical details (latency -> revenue / user retention)
- Present three options (expand, steady-state, scale-down) and recommend one (expand) with supporting ROI numbers
- Offer a short-term operational guarantee (SLA tweak or burst credits) to reduce perceived risk

END OF DOCUMENT — use this as a live working draft. Replace placeholders, paste route-level CSV, and mark "final" in header before sending to customer execs.

Document history: created by Priya Nair; iterated with Solutions Eng (Samir) and AE (Diego) for pilot numbers.
